CMR.note: The only birth link named is between BUNEC and the health sector, not the ID system.
It names no digital civil registration system, only an initiative between BUNEC and health on birth declaration.

systems.platform: OpenHIM, OpenFn on a server at CAMTEL

CMR.note: The platform described is the health ministry's health-sector platform, not a government-wide exchange.
It states nothing on HMIS or EMR use at clinics; DHIS2 and Bahmni are only named as systems to connect.

facts.fact: The health ministry communique says the national interoperability platform, with OpenHIM and OpenFn on a server at CAMTEL, already hosts use cases in universal health coverage, interconnecting enrolment and billing systems, and that not all systems are yet connected.

CMR.note: DHIS2 is only named among systems to interconnect; nothing states national reporting through it.
The document gives no ID enrolment figure.
The document says nothing about an ID number given at birth.
The revised interoperability framework pre-validated is for health systems only, a single sector, so not the government framework.
The document says nothing about local government connection.
